test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 30 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Choose the correct one-word substitute for:

A place where an army is trained.
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. Barracks .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Barracks"** refers to a place where soldiers or an army live and are trained.
